posts.title: How much more can nuclear power plants give?
posts.summary: In this age of rising electricity demand, people are trying to squeeze every last bit of power out of every power plant possible. Over the past few weeks, there’s been big news about nuclear power plants trying to do just that. Constellation, the largest nuclear operator in the US, announced plans to add nearly a…
bullets: US nuclear operators are shifting toward 'power uprates' to meet the surge in electricity demand driven by AI and data center expansion.
Major equipment overhauls, such as replacing turbines and transformers, can boost reactor capacity by up to 20%, though these projects require significant capital investment.
The industry is seeing a reversal of a decade-long trend where low natural gas prices and stagnant demand led to plant closures and reduced investment in capacity expansion.
Constellation Energy has announced a $4.3 billion investment plan for uprates, signaling a robust financial commitment to extending the utility of existing nuclear assets.

posts.title: Top EV battery makers' market share in China in September 2026: CATL 40.92%, BYD 21.09%
posts.summary:
CATL remained the leader, but its market share gap with BYD narrowed for the fourth consecutive month.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: CATL maintained its lead in the Chinese EV battery market with a 40.92% share in September, though its market share has declined for four consecutive months.
BYD continues to close the gap with the industry leader, holding a 21.09% market share, up slightly from the previous month.
The top five battery manufacturers now account for over 80% of the total market, with CALB, Eve Energy, and Gotion High-tech rounding out the top tier.

posts.title: China launches joint probe into Maextro V800 brake pedal bracket failures
posts.summary:
The brake pedal bracket on the Maextro V800 luxury MPV broke during a test, sparking widespread controversy.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Three Chinese government agencies have launched a joint investigation into brake pedal bracket failures on the Maextro V800, a luxury MPV developed by Huawei and JAC.
The probe follows viral footage from an automotive testing platform showing the bracket failing during emergency braking tests at 100 km/h.
While Maextro maintains that no such failures have occurred in real-world customer use, the company has pledged to improve the component's design and offer free upgrades to existing owners.

posts.title: Agentic AI Alters The CPU-GPU Balance
posts.summary:
Agentic workloads increase CPU demand, while reasoning models, MoE architectures, and reservoir computing fuel AI acceleration.
The post Agentic AI Alters The CPU-GPU Balance appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The rise of agentic AI, which requires complex decision-making and orchestration, is expected to shift the CPU-to-GPU ratio in data centers from 1:4 toward 1:1.
While GPUs remain essential for model inference, CPUs are increasingly critical for the 'if-then-else' logic required to manage autonomous agents.
Newer model architectures like Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and reasoning models continue to rely heavily on GPU acceleration, but they are increasingly being integrated into agentic workflows.

posts.title: How Close Are We To Fully Autonomous Chip Design?
posts.summary:
Synopsys CEO Sassine Ghazi talks about AI agents, the limits of autonomous engineering, digital twins, and the challenges facing 3D-ICs.
The post How Close Are We To Fully Autonomous Chip Design? appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Synopsys is shifting from AI-assisted design tools to long-horizon autonomous agents capable of orchestrating multiple tasks to achieve specific design outcomes.
Modern chip design now requires a holistic co-design approach that optimizes across physics, materials, process technology, architecture, and software simultaneously.
The industry has moved beyond simple generative AI to autonomous agents that can reason and trigger complex design flows based on high-level goals.
